objective: Prove deterministic reproducibility across the complete canonical P19-A through P19-F shadow/replay/digital-twin chain by verifying byte-identical same-run evidence, closed manifests, exact cross-workstream lineage and preserved safety/claim boundaries.
scope: Require exactly P19-A through P19-F in canonical order with no missing or duplicate workstreams
Require each workstream manifest to be CANONICAL_COMPLETE with lock RELEASED
Require each same-run evidence A/B pair to be byte-identical
Bind evidence bytes, canonical manifest, package and policy identities into a deterministic workstream reproducibility record
Verify cross-workstream same-run evidence lineage P19-C through P19-F
Verify manifest lineage references point to the exact canonical upstream manifests
Verify execution/order-routing/broker/Live/Auto authority remains disabled across all workstreams
Preserve P19-F claim boundary: REFERENCE_ONLY, UNAVAILABLE_PRE_P20_H, live_drift_validated=false
Emit a deterministic P19-A..P19-F reproducibility certificate and certificate identity
Run the P19-G audit twice byte-identically in Governance
out_of_scope: Promoting reference drift to Live drift
dependencies: Owner P19 phase authorization GRANTED / CONSUMED
tests: Exact A-F workstream set/order is required
Missing or duplicate workstream fails closed
Non-canonical manifest state or active lock fails closed
P20-started or Live/Auto-enabled record fails closed
Same records produce the same certificate identity
Cross-workstream evidence lineage is verified in canonical evidence
P19-G evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P19-G reproducibility package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P19-A..P19-F remain canonical complete and P19-H remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Strict CI and byte-identical evidence pass
